messages.text: BL-1835 🎵 in progress — The closing ceremony's own control pause holds its 'produce the morning briefing for <day>' note in the documenter's inbox (e9f91d6746, 2026-09-21: a pause holds every queued parcel), so the documenter cannot start the briefing until the pause lifts at the hard deadline - the same moment the ceremony writes the headless dump and stops the swarm - and every morning briefing since 2026-09-23 is the raw dump the human called ugly; the briefing instruction to the documenter is served during a pause, everything else stays held
